mapper.sql: CASE WHEN t.is_batch=1 THEN COALESCE(t.batch_status,t.status) ELSE t.status END
CASE WHEN t.is_batch=1 THEN t.batch_expires_at ELSE t.expires_at END
CASE WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 0 WHEN 'CANCELLING' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUEUED' THEN 2 WHEN 'PAUSED' THEN 3 WHEN 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
CASE t.status WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 0 WHEN 'CANCELLING' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUEUED' THEN 2 WHEN 'PAUSED' THEN 3 WHEN 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM background_task_relation r WHERE r.batch_id=#{taskId} AND r.task_id=t.id) AND t.type=#{type}AND t.status=#{status}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, FROM background_task t ORDER BY ,t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT t.status,COUNT(*) AS amount FROM background_task t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM background_task_relation r WHERE r.batch_id=#{taskId} AND r.task_id=t.id) GROUP BY t.status

SELECT b.id,b.name FROM background_task b JOIN background_task_relation r ON b.id=r.batch_id WHERE r.task_id=#{id} AND (b.batch_expires_at IS NULL OR b.batch_expires_at > #{now}) ORDER BY b.created_at DESC,b.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO background_task_relation(batch_id,task_id,created_at) VALUES(#{batchId},#{taskId},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_id=task_id ON CONFLICT(batch_id,task_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE background_task SET parent_id=#{batchId},is_batch=0 WHERE id=#{taskId} AND (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id=#{batchId})
UPDATE background_task SET batch_kind=#{kind},scope_sealed=#{sealed}, is_batch=CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id=#{id} AND batch_kind='UNCLASSIFIED'
UPDATE background_task SET scope_sealed=1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE background_task SET scope_sealed=1 WHERE batch_kind='AUTOMATIC' AND scope_sealed=0 AND business_id LIKE #{round} ESCAPE '!'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM background_task WHERE is_batch=1 AND id > #{cursor} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM background_task WHERE type='LOCAL_SCAN' AND status='INTERRUPTED' AND id > #{cursor} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM background_task WHERE batch_kind='UNCLASSIFIED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT t.status,COUNT(*) AS amount,MAX(t.finished_at) AS last_finished,MAX(t.expires_at) AS last_expiry, SUM(CASE WHEN t.finished_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_finished, SUM(CASE WHEN t.statistics_json LIKE '%"resultState":"UNKNOWN"%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uncertain FROM background_task_relation r JOIN background_task t ON t.id=r.task_id WHERE r.batch_id=#{id} GROUP BY t.status
SELECT reason FROM background_scan_scope WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','FAST') AND reason <> '' ORDER BY updated_at DESC,song_id LIMIT 1
SELECT reason FROM background_scan_scope WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state IN ('FAILED','INTERRUPTED','CANCELLED') AND reason <> '' ORDER BY updated_at DESC,song_id LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM media_source WHERE id=#{sourceId}
SELECT state,COUNT(*) AS amount,SUM(uncertain) AS uncertain FROM background_scan_scope WHERE batch_id=#{id} GROUP BY state

SELECT s.id,s.source_id, CASE WHEN r.song_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.identity_size ELSE s.file_size END AS file_size, CASE WHEN r.song_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.identity_modified ELSE s.modified_at END AS modified_at FROM media_song s LEFT JOIN webdav_resource r ON r.song_id=s.id AND r.archived_at IS NULL WHERE s.source_id=#{sourceId} AND s.id > #{cursor} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM media_scan_song staged WHERE staged.task_id=#{scanBusiness} AND staged.id=s.id) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 200
SELECT s.id,s.source_id,src.name AS source_name FROM media_song s JOIN media_source src ON src.id=s.source_id WHERE s.id=#{songId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO background_scan_scope(batch_id,song_id,fingerprint,state,current_job_id,reason,uncertain,updated_at) VALUES(#{batchId},#{songId},#{fingerprint},'PENDING',NULL,'等待后续发现',0,#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE song_id=song_id ON CONFLICT(batch_id,song_id,fingerprint) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO background_scan_scope(batch_id,song_id,fingerprint,state,current_job_id,reason,uncertain,updated_at) VALUES (#{r.batchId},#{r.songId},#{r.fingerprint},'PENDING',NULL,'等待后续发现',0,#{r.now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE song_id=song_id ON CONFLICT(batch_id,song_id,fingerprint) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT batch_id FROM background_scan_scope WHERE state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','FAST') AND batch_id > #{cursor} ORDER BY batch_id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE background_scan_scope SET state='SKIPPED',current_job_id=NULL,reason=#{reason},updated_at=#{now} WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','FAST')
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM background_scan_scope s JOIN background_task b ON b.id=s.batch_id WHERE s.song_id=#{songId} AND s.fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND s.state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','FAST') ORDER BY b.created_at,s.batch_id

SELECT s.* FROM background_scan_scope s WHERE s.state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','FAST') AND (s.batch_id > #{batchCursor} OR (s.batch_id=#{batchCursor} AND s.song_id > #{songCursor})) ORDER BY s.batch_id,s.song_id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE background_scan_scope SET state=#{state},current_job_id=#{jobId},reason=#{reason},uncertain=#{uncertain},updated_at=#{now} WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND song_id=#{songId} AND fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','FAST')
UPDATE background_scan_scope SET reason=#{reason},updated_at=#{now} WHERE state='PENDING' AND reason <> #{reason}
UPDATE background_scan_scope SET state=#{state},current_job_id=NULL,reason=#{reason},uncertain=#{uncertain},updated_at=#{now} WHERE current_job_id=#{jobId} AND state IN ('PROBING','FAST')
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT batch_id AS id FROM background_scan_scope WHERE current_job_id=#{jobId} AND state IN ('PROBING','FAST')
SELECT batch_id AS id FROM background_task_relation WHERE task_id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM background_task_relation WHERE batch_id=#{id} OR task_id=#{id}
